heading: Advanced Dental Care, From Implants to Same-Day Restorations
subheading: Dentiq combines cutting-edge technology with comprehensive treatments to restore, align, and perfect your smile.

items.name: 3D Printing
items.desc: In-office 3D printing delivers precise dental restorations and appliances faster than ever before.

items.name: All-On-4 Dental Implants
items.desc: Restore a full arch of teeth with just four strategically placed implants, often without bone grafting.

items.name: Bone and Soft Tissue Grafting
items.desc: Rebuild lost bone and tissue to create a healthy, stable foundation for implants and a natural appearance.

items.name: Bone Grafting
items.desc: Restore jawbone volume lost to disease or extraction so implants can be placed with lasting success.

items.name: CBCT Scanner
items.desc: 3D cone beam imaging gives your dentist a complete view of your jaw for safer, more accurate implant planning.

items.name: CEREC Same Day Crowns
items.desc: Get a custom-fitted, permanent crown designed and placed in a single appointment — no temporary needed.

items.name: Clear Aligners
items.desc: Straighten your teeth discreetly with removable, nearly invisible aligners tailored to your smile.

items.name: Dental Bonding
items.desc: Repair chips, close gaps, and smooth edges in one quick visit using tooth-colored resin.
